description: Browse live freelance job postings on Guru.com with server-side category, keyword, skill, location, budget and sort filters, or fetch full job detail pages by URL.

budgetType.description: Filter jobs by how the client wants to pay.
budgetType.title: Budget type

category.description: Guru.com top-level job category. Choose `all` to browse every category.
category.title: Category

includeDetails.description: When enabled, each browse result also opens its job-detail page, adding the full description, employer statistics and payment-verification badge. Costs one extra request per emitted job.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full detail pages (browse mode)

jobUrls.description: Full Guru.com job URLs, e.g. https://www.guru.com/jobs/dentist-website-in-wordpress/2119938 (copy the `jobUrl` field from a browse-mode record).
jobUrls.title: Job URLs (mode=byJobId)

keyword.description: Guru keyword search, e.g. `python`. Runs server-side through Guru's keyword/skill path; if Guru has no keyword match the actor falls back to filtering the category listing client-side.
keyword.title: Keyword (optional)

locations.description: Keep jobs whose client prefers these locations. Use a country name (`India`) or a Guru location path (`l/india`, `ls/united-states/new-york`, `lc/united-states/new-york/new-york`). Multiple entries are combined server-side.
locations.title: Locations (optional)

maxPages.description: Hard cap on the number of listing pages crawled (20 jobs/page).
maxPages.title: Max listing pages (mode=browse)

proxyConfiguration.description: Only used if Guru.com temporarily blocks direct requests. Defaults to the free Apify AUTO datacenter group.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

skills.description: Keep only jobs tagged with every listed skill, e.g. `python`, `automation-testing`. Guru applies these server-side.
skills.title: Skills (optional, all must match)

sortOrder.description: How Guru should order the listing. Guru honours budget sorts for Fixed Price jobs and hourly-rate sorts for Hourly jobs; the actor maps the equivalent sort automatically when they are combined.
sortOrder.title: Sort order

subcategory.description: Subcategory title or Guru slug within the selected category, e.g. `Web Development & Design` or `web-development-design`. Ignored when category=all.
subcategory.title: Subcategory (optional)

title: Guru Freelance Jobs Scraper Input
